tags.description: This resource represents plans. Use it to get, create, duplicate, update, trash and archive plans.
tags.name: Plans

tags.description: This resource represents planning settings for plan-only and Atlassian teams in a plan. Use it to get, create, update and delete planning settings.
tags.name: Teams in plan

get.description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of plans.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: Whether to include trashed plans in the results.
parameters.name: includeTrashed

parameters.description: Whether to include archived plans in the results.
parameters.name: includeArchived

parameters.description: The cursor to start from. If not provided, the first page will be returned.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of plans to return per page. The maximum value is 50. The default value is 50.
parameters.name: maxResults

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the user is not logged in.

403.description: Returned if the site has no premium edition of Jira or if the user does not have the Administer Jira global permission.

parameters.description: Whether to accept group IDs instead of group names. Group names are deprecated.
parameters.name: useGroupId

201.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the user is not logged in.

403.description: Returned if the site has no premium edition of Jira or if the user does not have the Administer Jira global permission.

parameters.description: The ID of the plan.
parameters.name: planId

parameters.description: Whether to return group IDs instead of group names. Group names are deprecated.
parameters.name: useGroupId

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

put.description:
Updates any of the following details of a plan using [JSON Patch](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6902).

 *  name
 *  leadAccountId
 *  scheduling
    
     *  estimation with StoryPoints, Days or Hours as possible values
     *  startDate
        
         *  type with DueDate, TargetStartDate, TargetEndDate or DateCustomField as possible values
         *  dateCustomFieldId
     *  endDate
        
         *  type with DueDate, TargetStartDate, TargetEndDate or DateCustomField as possible values
         *  dateCustomFieldId
     *  inferredDates with None, SprintDates or ReleaseDates as possible values
     *  dependencies with Sequential or Concurrent as possible values
 *  issueSources
    
     *  type with Board, Project or Filter as possible values
     *  value
 *  exclusionRules
    
     *  numberOfDaysToShowCompletedIssues
     *  issueIds
     *  workStatusIds
     *  workStatusCategoryIds
     *  issueTypeIds
     *  releaseIds
 *  crossProjectReleases
    
     *  name
     *  releaseIds
 *  customFields
    
     *  customFieldId
     *  filter
 *  permissions
    
     *  type with View or Edit as possible values
     *  holder
        
         *  type with Group or AccountId as possible values
         *  value

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

*Note that "add" operations do not respect array indexes in target locations. Call the "Get plan" endpoint to find out the order of array elements.*

parameters.description: The ID of the plan.
parameters.name: planId

parameters.description: Whether to accept group IDs instead of group names. Group names are deprecated.
parameters.name: useGroupId

basicAuth.description: You can access this resource via basic auth.

scopes.delete:project:jira: Delete projects and their details, such as issue types, project lead, and avatars.
scopes.manage:jira-configuration: Configure Jira settings that require the Jira administrators permission, for example, create projects and custom fields, view workflows, manage issue link types.
scopes.manage:jira-project: Create and edit project settings and create new project-level objects, for example, versions, components.
scopes.manage:jira-webhook: Manage Jira webhooks. Enables an OAuth app to register and unregister dynamic webhooks in Jira. It also provides for fetching of registered webhooks.
scopes.read:email-address:jira: View email addresses of all users regardless of the user's profile visibility settings.
scopes.read:jira-user: View user information in Jira that you have access to, including usernames, email addresses, and avatars.
scopes.read:jira-work: Read project and issue data. Search for issues and objects associated with issues (such as attachments and worklogs).
scopes.write:avatar:jira: Create and update system and custom avatars.
scopes.write:comment.property:jira: Create and update issue comment properties.
scopes.write:field-configuration-scheme:jira: Create and update field configuration schemes.
scopes.write:field.default-value:jira: Create and update field default values.
scopes.write:filter.default-share-scope:jira: Create and update filter default share scopes.
scopes.write:issue-link-type:jira: Create and update issue link types.
scopes.write:issue-type-scheme:jira: Create and update issue type schemes.
scopes.write:issue-type-screen-scheme:jira: Create and update issue type screen schemes.
scopes.write:issue-type.property:jira: Create and update issue type properties.
scopes.write:issue-worklog.property:jira: Create and update issue worklog properties.
scopes.write:issue.remote-link:jira: Create and update issue remote links.
scopes.write:issue.time-tracking:jira: Create and update issue time trackings.
scopes.write:jira-work: Create and edit issues in Jira, post comments, create worklogs, and delete issues.
